M1.contract:
Implement only this milestone, reusing verified dependencies without overwriting their artifacts.
The source module exposes MILESTONE_ID as the literal milestone identifier (M1 etc.) and handle(data_dir, request). data_dir is a filesystem path; request is a JSON-compatible dict with an op string. Return a JSON-compatible dict. Invalid input, unknown IDs, cross-project access and unsupported operations raise ValueError. Do not return success-shaped error objects. Persistence must survive another Python process; storage format and internal design are Agent-owned. Read all needed dependency source contracts before integration. Existing modules may be discovered by their literal MILESTONE_ID, not guessed hash filenames. Dependencies may be imported normally or via importlib. Standard library only for the application; public tests may use pytest. No public network publication or dependency installation. Return one aggregate acceptance intent for this milestone: its independent suite covers every public behavior below, so no requirement is dropped. Worker-authored tests must exercise actual behavior.

Current milestone M1:
Project Workspace. handle ops: project.create(name) -> {id,name}; project.get(project_id) -> same record; project.list() -> {items:[records]}. IDs are nonempty opaque strings, stable across reopening, different for different projects even with identical names. Reject empty/whitespace-only names and missing IDs. A new store lists no projects. Names preserve Unicode. Two distinct data_dir stores are isolated. Create/open/list survive a fresh process. Do not impose a database schema on subsequent milestones.
M1.finding: project.list returns items. Tests expecting projects contradict frozen public contract; correcting their key preserves the specified behavior.

Current milestone M6:
Approval. approval.review(project_id,content_id)->{content_id,revision,status:REVIEW}; approval.approve(project_id,content_id)->{content_id,revision,status:APPROVED}; approval.status(project_id,content_id)->{content_id,revision,status}. Approve only after review of the same current revision, with every claim currently SUPPORTED and every referenced media asset present/valid (media can be empty before M11). A semantic content.edit makes the current approval status DRAFT; old approval remains historical and cannot authorize new content. Reject unsupported/stale/conflicting claims, missing media, foreign content, and approve-before-review. Persist decisions and exact revision bindings. Downstream publication/scheduling must consult current validity, not a stale approved boolean.
M6.finding: Missing media must be rejected even though media may be empty before M11. Do not weaken the existing missing-media negative test.
